TRACEABLE FROM RAW DATA TO INTERFACE

Evidence, with its limits.

Inspect the checks behind the implementation before writing the milestone document.

Scope retained after the M3 audit

We compare errors and review workload within selected recordings. The original five-independent-case rule stays in force; the broader class-by-season generalization claim remains blocked.

Source channels are converted from Kelvin and target channels from Fahrenheit to Celsius. Nominal units and signal roles are checked; command values do not prove actual positions or equivalent multi-zone/single-zone dynamics.

Target labels were previously exposed. All target results are explicitly retrospective and exploratory.

Reproduction & artifacts

Training runs in the Python backend. This hosted UI executes the exported trained RF and TCN models locally; it does not train networks in your browser. The backend includes controlled feedback training and rollback.
